MemCmp(void*, void*, nuint)

Compares two blocks of memory byte by byte for a specified length.

public static int MemCmp(void* ptr1, void* ptr2, nuint size)

Parameters

ptr1 void*

A pointer to the first block of memory to compare.

ptr2 void*

A pointer to the second block of memory to compare.

size nuint

The number of bytes to compare. Must not exceed the length of either memory block.

Returns

int

A signed integer that indicates the relative order of the memory blocks: less than zero if the first differing byte in ptr1 is less than the corresponding byte in ptr2; zero if all compared bytes are equal; greater than zero if the first differing byte in ptr1 is greater than the corresponding byte in ptr2.
